title: ECAS Experiment Data and Offline Replay for API Security Rules
description: Fixed evaluation artifacts for ECAS: Evidence Contracts for API Security Rule Construction and Evaluation. The archive separates the unchanged original 30-task evaluation from later seven-case comparisons using adapted P2P and AutoPAC workflows, 95 related evidence/schema controls, and retained source/state studies. It includes tasks, prompts, public model outputs, policies, request fixtures, results, failures, schemas, the fixed ECAS interpreter and a credential-free archived-output replay. The exact OPA tool is obtained from its official release with a pinned digest before offline replay. No model weights or credentials are included. The source-linked 673-check matrices are a separate resource. Version 1.0.0 accompanies the A18 revised manuscript. Original author data and documentation are licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0; original author software is licensed under Apache-2.0. The unchanged original R12 archive, where present, and third-party materials retain their original terms. These exceptions are identified in LICENSE_STATUS.md and LICENSE_SCOPE.csv. This work was supported by the Discipline Breakthrough Pioneer Program of the Ministry of Education of China (Grant No. JYB2025XDXM122).
